description: This file defines a plugin for the gogo/protobuf code generator that creates interface and struct methods for protobuf message types to support 'face' conversions and testing.

classes.name: plugin
classes.description: A struct implementing the protobuf code generator plugin for 'face' interface generation.

methods.name: NewPlugin
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the face plugin.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the plugin, 'face'.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the generator instance.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates interface and method code for protobuf message types marked with the 'face' option.
